title: 澳大利亚称可能效仿加拿大与欧盟建立更紧密关系
summary: 据《独立报》报道，澳大利亚表示可能跟随加拿大的做法，与欧盟建立更深入的经济与贸易联系。该报道发布在 Hacker News 上，获得 227 分和 186 条评论，引发广泛讨论。文章背景涉及美国贸易政策的不确定性，加拿大与欧盟此前已推进更紧密的双边合作，澳大利亚此番表态被视为在美澳贸易关系之外寻求多元化伙伴关系的信号。讨论焦点包括地缘政治格局变化、贸易联盟重组以及中等强国如何在大国博弈中维护自身经济利益。
summary_en: According to The Independent, Australia has indicated it could follow Canada's lead in forging deeper ties with the European Union. The story, shared on Hacker News with 227 points and 186 comments, comes amid uncertainty over US trade policy. Canada has already moved toward closer bilateral cooperation with the EU, and Australia's remarks are seen as a signal to diversify partnerships beyond its US trade relationship. Discussion centers on shifting geopolitics, realignment of trade alliances, and how middle powers protect their economic interests amid great-power competition.
